releases.body:
Fixes wrapped text alignment for child rows in the Subagents sidebar section.

The title and activity lines previously wrapped back to column 0 on long text, instead of aligning under their own text. Restructured each row into a fixed-width prefix column (icon, or the activity arrow) next to a growing text column, so wrapped lines now align under themselves.

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-subagents-view

Comment-only change, no functional difference from v0.2.5. Moved the explanation for the @jsxImportSource pragma out of source and into the README, where the full rationale already lived.

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-subagents-view

Fixes two real bugs affecting anyone installing this plugin the normal way, via opencode's own "Install Plugin" command or a plain npm install:

- solid-js resolved to its non-reactive SSR build, since neither approach runs lifecycle scripts. Fixed by patching solid-js's exports in the plugin's own load path instead of at install time.
- This plugin's own JSX resolved to a broken assumption of React's runtime, since Bun ignores tsconfig.json and per-file JSX pragmas for anything inside node_modules. Fixed by escaping node_modules to load the implementation when needed.

Verified end to end against a real opencode instance using its own "Install Plugin" command against the actual published package, starting from a completely clean state.

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-subagents-view

Fixes the README shown on the npm package page (the 0.1.0 publish captured an outdated README that still said "not yet published to npm").

No code changes, docs only.

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-subagents-view

First published release on npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-subagents-view

Live Subagents sidebar panel for OpenCode's TUI, with per-row status icons, live activity text, idle-run reset behavior, and mouse collapse/expand.
